text:
Maria: Quick sync — merge window tomorrow 11:00 PT. We have a cross-repo interlock: API PR #198 changes the response schema (breaking), SDK PR #432 depends on it, and Console PR #56 expects the old keys. Who can coordinate merges/flags so we don't take the whole stack down? @Alex @Sam @Linh
Alex: I can land #198 today but want to do it behind a feature flag and a small canary. I added the DB migration in the PR, but need someone to approve the rollout policy (canary %, duration). Ping @Chris for rollout guidance.
Sam: SDK #432 already updated for new shape but CI is failing because console integration tests still assert old keys. I can slip in a compatibility shim that returns both shapes for 7 days if we need a smoother handoff.
Linh: Console #56 is just a prop rename in the UI. If the backend returns both keys for a short window we can merge immediately. Prefer shim on API vs blocking console.
Chris: Proposed plan (to reduce blast radius):
1) Alex lands API #198 behind flag `api.enable_new_schema` with 10% canary for 2h.
2) Sam ships a small compatibility shim in SDK that maps old->new keys for requests from Console for 7 days.
3) Linh merges Console #56 once SDK is green.
4) After monitoring and metrics look good, remove flag and delete shim.
I can own post-merge smoke tests and rollback steps.
Sam: OK I can push the shim today. Where do we register the flag? runtime/flags service or env var? Also will the shim be a separate PR or part of #432?
Alex: I'll create the flag `api.enable_new_schema` in runtime/flags and add it gated in the serializer. Canary plan: 10% for 2h -> 50% for 1h -> 100% if no errors. I will add a deploy check to abort on 5xx spike.
Sam: I'll open a small PR with the shim as a follow-up to #432 (so reviewers can see compatibility layer). It will be labeled `compat-shim` and included in the release notes.
Linh: Sounds good. I'll hold the console merge until SDK `compat-shim` is merged and CI green. After console merge, we need runtime/helm bump to pick the new env var. Example values to update:
```yaml
env:
  - name: API_ENABLE_NEW_SCHEMA
    value: "false" # switch to true during canary
```
I can add the helm bump in Console's release PR.
Maria: Nice. Volunteers: @Alex will do flag + canary, @Sam will add SDK shim, @Linh will handle helm bump and merge console after SDK green, @Chris will run post-merge smoke checks. I'll coordinate merge timing during the 11:00 PT window and monitor.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: feature-flag creation task queued. Canary rollout job will be created after feature-flag toggle — https://ci.internal/jobs/3092 :rocket:
Alex: I'll aim to have flag + gated API deploy done by EOD. If anyone hits blocking CI, @me and I'll try to triage immediately.
Sam: I'll target a shim PR within the next 2 hours. Will add clear TODO to remove shim after 7 days.
Maria: Great — if anything slips we push to the next day's 11:00 window. Thanks all :thumbsup:
